title: Dictator value from low edge error
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a sign tester, and let $r$ be a natural number such that every predicate used by $T$ has arity at most $r$. Suppose there are real numbers $\beta$ and $\delta$ such that, for every alphabet coordinate, $T$ accepts the corresponding dictator function with probability at least $\beta$. If a vertex labeling has edge error at most $\delta$, then the long-code experiment using the dictator functions specified by that labeling has value at least $\beta-r\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A natural number $r$ bounding every predicate arity
Every dictator function has tester acceptance probability at least $\beta$
The labeling's edge error is at most $\delta$
